instruction.text: There are two main types of rural land use. Read the text and select the matching image.

atoms.a: Using land for agriculture involves growing crops or rearing animals.
Using land for forestry involves growing trees, harvesting timber and protecting forests.

atoms.b: A lot of Earth’s rural land is used for agriculture, more commonly known as ((celebrating ++farming)).
The way that farmland is used depends on the climate and the conditions of the ((++ground phones)). Many farms are also used for more than one type of farming.

instruction.text: What percentage of the Earth’s rural land do you think is used for agriculture?
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: There are three main types of agriculture. The first is hill farming. This involves hilly areas that have colder temperatures and low quality grass being used for sheep.
The second use for agricultural land is arable farming, which involves growing crops. The soil must be good quality, and the land must be flat so that machinery can be used.
Cattle farming is the third type of agriculture. This requires warm, wet conditions so that the cattle have healthy grass to graze on. These farms produce meat and dairy products.

atoms.a: What animal is hill farming used for?
What products do cattle farms produce?
Most farmers make an income from agriculture.

feedback.end: Farmers make money through selling meat, dairy and crops. Some farms even have a farm shop on their land, in which they can sell their produce.

instruction.text: You are speaking with a forester about forestry. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: What do you do as a ((doctor ++forester))?
atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch='-1st'>What do you do as a forester?</prosody>

atoms.b: I mainly manage timber production in ((shops ++forests)). This involves selecting the right trees to cut down, harvesting them and also ((reheating ++replanting)) trees afterwards.

atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch='-1st'>Do you also protect the forests</prosody>

atoms.b: Yes! It is very important that we manage any  threats to our forests, such as ((window ++insect)) infestations, wildfires and diseases.
As foresters, we also aim to protect and increase forest biodiversity by sustaining healthy ((buildings ++habitats)) for different animals.
